description: This is a code-behind file for a web page in an online examination system. It handles page load and button click events that navigate to different pages such as Dashboard, UserProfile, Leaderboard, and LoginPage.

classes.name: TakenCourses
classes.description: A code-behind class for the TakenCourses.aspx page, handling navigation button events.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; currently does nothing.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles the event when the home button is clicked; navigates to Dashboard.aspx.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles the event when the profile button is clicked; navigates to UserProfile.aspx.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles the event when the leaderboard button is clicked; navigates to Leaderboard.aspx.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles the event when the logout button is clicked; navigates to LoginPage.aspx.
